# Supabase: saved copies and goldens

Real copies of what Supabase publishes, read by this folder's tests instead of the network: each row says where it was fetched, when, its license and a quote. The golden files under `golden/` are every event the tests must store; `go test ./providers/supabase -update` rewrites them after an intended change, and the PR says why the new output is right.

## Saved OpenAPI spec excerpts

Each pair is a real breaking change between two releases of the provider's own spec, trimmed to the schemas and paths involved: every line is copied unchanged, the rest of the spec was left out. The tests replay one release to the next and check the events.

| Files | Source | Checked | License | Quote |
|---|---|---|---|---|

(`POST /v1/projects/{ref}/functions`, new in `bf04ff66`) |
| `supabase-693bdc38.json`, `supabase-eb21ae25.json` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/supabase/supabase/693bdc38d045353e5782f86febff4fddc82bb93a/apps/docs/spec/api_v1_openapi.json (and `eb21ae25f7954ea1e5db34209ff69fce597b0ae3`) | 2026-11-19 | Apache-2.0 (supabase/supabase) | `"deprecated": true` on `GET /v1/projects/{ref}/analytics/endpoints/logs.all` (new in `eb21ae25`) |
| `supabase-8aef4a08.json`, `supabase-90b71e3e.json` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/supabase/supabase/8aef4a08bf56e1e0e1eb8af316f7f0b2bcfd2e88/apps/docs/spec/api_v1_openapi.json (and `90b71e3e42c5f933013e1a62acdc37c07e9378d7`) | 2026-11-19 | Apache-2.0 (supabase/supabase) | `/v1/projects/{ref}/analytics/warehouse/...` (14 operations in `8aef4a08`, none deprecated, all gone in `90b71e3e`): the drop test |
| `supabase-de806266.json`, `supabase-a5fc0527.json` | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/supabase/supabase/de806266717abddb08e285f9dd6d17ad7d262b34/apps/docs/spec/api_v1_openapi.json (and `a5fc0527045daaafd2a661146cac0b430adad20b`) | 2026-11-19 | Apache-2.0 (supabase/supabase) | `/v1/branches/{branch_id}` (in `de806266`), `/v1/branches/{branch_id_or_ref}` (in `a5fc0527`) |

The Supabase copies keep each value unchanged but are re-indented: the source is Prettier-formatted (objects on one line where they fit), and minified on one line before 2025.
